newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai inflation growth lowest in five years.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai inflation growth lowest in five years.

text.p: Shanghai's inflation rate in the first half of the year was the lowest in five years, with retail price inflation at a year-on-year 6.1 percent, the Business News said on Monday.

Actual per capita income of Shanghai residents after inflation rose 4.2 percent to 645 yuan in the first six months of this year, compared with a year-on-year 3.3 percent in the first half of last year, the newspaper said.
"There were few administrative measures resulting in price rises in Shanghai this year," it said.
But the newspaper quoted experts as saying prices were likely to rise a little faster during the rest of this year.
